name: local-perf-v2
calibration_policy: fresh bracketed candidates; independent reference boundaries per set; calibration budget exhaustion is inconclusive
w4_generator_missed_policy: nonzero missed scheduled arrivals make qualification inconclusive; no offers after cutoff
w5_lifecycle_process: one persistent runtime per candidate; three normal-close and queued-disconnect cycles; original idle baseline
endpoint_cpu_selection: first two allowed CPUs; all clients share first, peer second; independent measurements serialized
tail_backlog_envelope: ceil(per-stream rate * capacity_p99_us / 1000000), every last-quarter sample
capacity_sample_policy: every scheduled boundary through boundary + service allowance; receiver sample[2] in-window validated
limiter_assessment: artifact-bound local assessment after diagnostic collection; missing assessment is inconclusive
coverage: five-set capacity and latency on 64-byte W1 both directions and one-connection symmetric W2; other ten cases screened only; prior unchanged protocol and ownership qualifications reused
